instruction: In my file system, add the prefix "YYYY-MM-DD_" to all file names in the ~/downloads/ directory, based on their creation dates, and then move all files not from this year to ~/trash/.
notes: The contents of ~/downloads/ are unknown before any API call, so four placeholder files are modeled (file-1, file-2 created this year; file-3, file-4 created in earlier years); the real listing from show_directory determines the actual number and each file's show_file/move_file pair is repeated accordingly. Files are domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task can structurally require every goal condition (moved file-i). World facts (file creation year, current year) are static in :init while knowledge gates (directory-listed, known-creation-date, current-date-known, profile-known, passwords-known) force the lookup calls. The 'this year vs. earlier' rule is encoded as the static lookup (destination-dir file-year current-year dir): same-year files are renamed in place in ~/downloads/, older files are renamed into ~/trash/; each file has both candidate prefixed paths so the planner must apply the rule. A single move_file call performs rename+relocation, matching the reference solution. phone.get_current_date_and_time needs no login and is used to determine the current year; the file_system username is the supervisor email from show_profile.

plan: (file-system-move-file file-1 downloads-dated-file-1 file-system-token downloads year-2023 year-2023)
(file-system-move-file file-2 downloads-dated-file-2 file-system-token downloads year-2023 year-2023)
(file-system-move-file file-3 trash-dated-file-3 file-system-token trash year-2022 year-2023)
(file-system-move-file file-4 trash-dated-file-4 file-system-token trash year-2021 year-2023)
